columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Nested HITL needs durable continuation across workflow and agent-tool boundaries
columns.title_zh: 嵌套 HITL 需要跨工作流与 Agent Tool 的持久续接语义
columns.source_zh: Google ADK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260830-003 with Skill 02 score 46/50. The merged ADK mechanism preserves nested human-in-the-loop pause/resume state across workflows and agent tools instead of treating approval as a one-shot prompt. It creates a bounded digital-employee question: which continuation state must be durable so a nested approval can resume the correct workflow frame after multiple turns without losing or widening authority?
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260830-003，Skill 02 评分 46/50。ADK 已合并机制在 Workflow 与 Agent Tool 之间保留嵌套人机协同的暂停/恢复状态，而不是把审批视为一次性 Prompt。它形成一个边界清晰的数字员工问题：哪些 Continuation State 必须持久化，才能让嵌套审批在跨越多轮后恢复到正确的 Workflow Frame，同时不丢失或扩大原有权限？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the nested pause/resume state model, persisted continuation identity, human-response binding, workflow-frame restoration, repeated-turn behavior, failure/cancellation paths, and tests proving the resumed action cannot attach to the wrong nested frame.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验嵌套 Pause/Resume 状态模型、持久 Continuation Identity、人工响应绑定、Workflow Frame 恢复、多轮重复行为、失败/取消路径，以及哪些测试证明恢复动作不会绑定到错误的嵌套 Frame。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Agent action gates can fail even when belief does not move
columns.title_zh: Agent 的行动门禁可能在信念几乎不变时失守
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260830-011 with Skill 02 score 47/50. Across 12 frontier models, fabricated professional-looking evidence sharply increased commitment on unknowable tasks while reported belief barely moved, localizing a safety failure at the transition from epistemic state to action. This is a question-first architecture object with unusually strong cross-model evidence: what independent qualification gate should prevent action when evidence presentation changes commitment without improving factual support?
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260830-011，Skill 02 评分 47/50。研究覆盖 12 个前沿模型：伪造但具有专业外观的证据显著提高不可知任务上的行动承诺，而模型报告的信念几乎没有变化，说明安全失效主要发生在“认知状态 → 行动”转换门禁。它是一个具有强跨模型证据的 Question-first 架构对象：当证据呈现只提高行动承诺却没有改善事实支持时，系统需要什么独立 Qualification Gate 来阻止执行？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the experimental construction, commitment-versus-belief measurements, per-model and per-condition effect sizes, unknowable-task controls, format effects, training interventions, limitations, and whether the evidence supports an architecture-level separation between belief estimation and action qualification.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验实验构造、Commitment 与 Belief 的测量方式、各模型/条件效应量、不可知任务对照、格式效应、训练干预、局限性，以及证据是否足以支持在架构上分离“信念估计”与“行动资格判定”。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Incremental checkpoint state needs bounded growth without sacrificing resume semantics
columns.title_zh: 增量 Checkpoint 状态需要在不牺牲恢复语义的前提下限制增长
columns.source_zh: LangChain / LangGraph 官方技术说明
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260830-008 with Skill 02 score 41/50. DeltaChannel separates incremental state deltas from periodic materialized snapshots so long-running agents can bound checkpoint growth while preserving resume and HITL behavior. It is a concrete runtime-engineering question distinct from today's approval and action-gate objects: how should a durable agent compact state without losing the replay information required for deterministic continuation?
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260830-008，Skill 02 评分 41/50。DeltaChannel 将增量状态 Delta 与周期性物化 Snapshot 分离，使长运行 Agent 能限制 Checkpoint 增长，同时保留 Resume 与 HITL 行为。它与今日审批和行动门禁对象形成明确区分，是一个具体运行时工程问题：持久 Agent 应如何压缩状态，同时不丢失确定性续接所需的 Replay 信息？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify DeltaChannel's delta/snapshot representation, compaction boundary, replay and resume invariants, HITL interaction, persistence/storage assumptions, failure recovery, migration compatibility, and tests or benchmarks that demonstrate bounded growth without semantic loss.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 DeltaChannel 的 Delta/Snapshot 表示、Compaction Boundary、Replay 与 Resume 不变量、HITL 交互、持久化/存储假设、失败恢复、迁移兼容性，以及证明“增长有界但语义不丢失”的测试或 Benchmark。
